knowledge:
- key_parameters: Strandtype=Specifies the strand of the sequencing (e.g., "forward", "invert") in PASEXP_3UTR, PASEXP_IPA, and GENEXP_CDS ;; nts=Number of threads passed to Rsubread::featureCounts in PASEXP_IPA to increase calculation speed ;; conKET=Control group condition name in APAdiff ;; trtKEY=Treatment group condition name in APAdiff ;; PAS=Type of PAS analyzed ('3UTR' or 'IPA') in APAdiff ;; CUTreads=Read count cutoff for filtering in APAdiff (default 0) ;; p_adjust_methods=P-value correction method in APAdiff (default "fdr") ;; MultiTest=Statistical method for replicate designs in APAdiff ('unpaired t-test', 'paired t-test', or 'ANOVA') ;; AnnoMethod=Annotation method in PAS2GEF ('legacy' or 'V2') ;; StrandType=Strand type for paired-end BAM extraction in ThreeMostPairBam ('forward-reverse', 'reverse-forward', or 'NONE') ;; SeqType=Set to 'ThreeMostPairEnd' in PASEXP_IPA when using 3'-most extracted alignments
- alternatives: DEXSeq=Mentioned as an alternative tool based on negative binomial data distribution for significance analysis of replicate designs
- when_to_use: Appropriate when analyzing alternative polyadenylation (APA) events (3'UTR lengthening/shortening or intronic polyadenylation) and gene expression changes from RNA-seq BAM files
- pitfalls: makeTxDbFromUCSC=Can throw errors; the docs suggest upgrading Bioconductor, loading genome annotation via GTF, or using prebuilt '.R.DB' files ;; Strandtype=Must be correctly specified based on the RNA-seq library preparation to avoid incorrect read counting ;; Paired-end data=Standard paired-end BAM files should have their 3'-most alignments extracted using ThreeMostPairBam before running PASEXP_3UTR and PASEXP_IPA (with SeqType='ThreeMostPairEnd') to ensure accurate APA analysis

workflows.name: apa_analysis_workflow
workflows.intent: Quantify and analyze differential alternative polyadenylation (APA) in 3'UTRs and introns from RNA-seq BAM files.
input: flsall (named vector of paths to BAM files)
refUTRraw (data frame of 3'UTR PAS genomic information)
dfIPA (data frame of intronic PAS genomic information)
dfLE (data frame of 3' least exon genomic information)
workflows.stages: 1. Build PAS reference regions using REF4PAS ;; 2. Build 3'UTR aUTR and cUTR references using REF3UTR ;; 3. Calculate relative expression of 3'UTR APA using PASEXP_3UTR ;; 4. Calculate relative expression of intronic PAS (IPA) using PASEXP_IPA ;; 5. Perform differential APA analysis using APAdiff ;; 6. Visualize results using APAVolcano and APABox
workflows.code:
PASREF=REF4PAS(refUTRraw,dfIPAraw,dfLEraw)
UTRdbraw=PASREF$UTRdbraw
dfIPA=PASREF$dfIPA
dfLE=PASREF$dfLE
UTRdbraw=REF3UTR(refUTRraw)
DFUTRraw=PASEXP_3UTR(UTRdbraw, flsall, Strandtype="forward")
IPA_OUTraw=PASEXP_IPA(dfIPA, dfLE, flsall, Strandtype="forward", nts=1)
sampleTable1 = data.frame(samplename = c(names(flsall)), condition = c(rep("NT",3),rep("KD",3)))
sampleTable2 = data.frame(samplename = c("SRR316184","SRR316187"), condition = c("NT","KD"))
test_3UTRsing=APAdiff(sampleTable2,DFUTRraw, 
                        conKET='NT',
                        trtKEY='KD',
                        PAS='3UTR',
                        CUTreads=0,
                        p_adjust_methods="fdr")
test_3UTRmuti=APAdiff(sampleTable1,
                        DFUTRraw, 
                        conKET='NT',
                        trtKEY='KD',
                        PAS='3UTR',
                        CUTreads=0,
                        p_adjust_methods="fdr",
                        MultiTest='unpaired t-test')
test_IPAsing=APAdiff(sampleTable2,
                        IPA_OUTraw, 
                        conKET='NT',
                        trtKEY='KD',
                        PAS='IPA',
                        CUTreads=0,
                        p_adjust_methods="fdr") 
test_IPAmuti=APAdiff(sampleTable1,
                        IPA_OUTraw, 
                        conKET='NT',
                        trtKEY='KD',
                        PAS='IPA',
                        CUTreads=0,
                        p_adjust_methods="fdr",
                        MultiTest='unpaired t-test')
APAVolcano(test_3UTRsing, PAS='3UTR', Pcol = "pvalue", top=5, main='3UTR APA')
APABox(test_3UTRsing, xlab = "APAreg", ylab = "RED", plot_title = NULL)

workflows.name: paired_end_3most_extraction
workflows.intent: Extract the 3'-most alignment from paired-end BAM files to prepare them for accurate APA analysis.
input: Bamfile (path to input paired-end BAM file)
workflows.stages: 1. Extract 3'-most alignments using ThreeMostPairBam ;; 2. Use the extracted BAM file in PASEXP_IPA with SeqType set to 'ThreeMostPairEnd'
workflows.code:
ThreeMostPairBam (BamfilePath=Bamfile,
					OutDirPath=Outdir,
					StrandType='forward-reverse')
IPA_OUTraw=PASEXP_IPA(dfIPA, dfLE, ThreemostBamfile, Strandtype="forward", SeqType="ThreeMostPairEnd")

workflows.name: gene_expression_analysis
workflows.intent: Assess gene expression changes using RNA-seq reads mapped to coding sequences (CDS).
input: IDDB (org.Db object for gene identifier mapping)
flsall (named vector of paths to BAM files)
workflows.stages: 1. Build coding region references using REFCDS ;; 2. Calculate gene expression using GENEXP_CDS
